pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: By defeating Ulfric at Whiterun we have solidified the allegiance of the jarl.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0A6CD7 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: We've driven the Imperials out of Whiterun. This is good. Very good. We now control the center. It's a powerful position. One I aim to keep.

pointers.speaker: Captain Aldis
pointers.words: Her daughter was sent to Whiterun, the skirmishes there have been violent. The Whiterun Legate, he needed to know the Stormcloak positions.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:034B33 (Narrative Gameplay Consistent Dialogue Tweaks.esp)

pointers.speaker: Angeline Morrard
pointers.words: It's good to see a fresh face. You wouldn't have happen to come from Whiterun would you?

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: Name's Ennis. If you've got friends who do business in Whiterun, they might know me.

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: You here from the city? I visit Whiterun from time to time, mostly to make deals.
Come on now, we discussed that. I wouldn't be traveling all of Skyrim. It'd just to Whiterun and back, that's it.
Trust in me, Whiterun! Trust in Heimskr! For I am the chosen of Talos! I alone have been anointed by the Ninth to spread his holy word!
Brynjolf, have you had a chance to speak to our contact in Whiterun?

pointers.speaker: Idgrod the Younger
pointers.words: We were taking him to the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun, just so the healers could make sure he was in good health, and they say he's fine.

pointers.speaker: Alessandra
pointers.words: I'd like to make the journey to the Hall of the Dead in Whiterun and give my ceremonial dagger to Andurs, the caretaker.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:043DF3 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Gabriella
pointers.words: Do that, and Astrid has authorized me to grant you a rather unique bonus. It is a special token, to be given to Olava the Feeble, in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Paarthurnax
pointers.words: Perhaps the hofkahsejun - the palace in Whiterun... Dragonsreach. It was originally built to house a captive dovah.
They say he Shouted it into submission in single combat atop Mount Anthor and brought it back to Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:045D0A (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Esbern
pointers.words: I'm sure you'll manage, though. If you can defeat the World-Eater, surely sweet-talking the Jarl of Whiterun isn't beyond you.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D0708 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Oh, yes... spices. That was a special order for someone in Whiterun. Should be along any day now. Don't let it worry you, my dear.

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: It's true that Whiterun is dangerously exposed as long as the Stormcloaks hold Markarth...

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: Regaining Pale Pass would help our supply situation considerably... and Whiterun is dangerously exposed with the enemy in Falkreath...

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Blocking Pale Pass would cut one of the main Imperial supply routes... and Whiterun is dangerously exposed with the enemy in Falkreath.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Blocking Pale Pass would cut one of the main Imperial supply routes... and would leave Whiterun dangerously exposed...

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: In exchange for Markarth, the source of most of Skyrim's silver? Hardly. I might rather consider Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Sabjorn
pointers.words: Maven Black-Briar's gone out of her way to try and have me shut down, but fortunately I have a good relationship with Whiterun's jarl.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:04E397 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Speak with Amaund Motierre at the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. He will know the true Emperor's location.

pointers.speaker: Maven Black-Briar
pointers.words: Yes, we spoke at length while you were in Whiterun dealing with our meadery situation.
Just head north - you can't miss it. It's the capital of Whiterun Hold.
Cross the river and then head north. You'll see Whiterun on its hill as you pass the falls.
A citizen of Whiterun has asked for our help.
The Jarl of Whiterun has asked for our help.
We've got trouble right here in Whiterun Hold. Nothing we can't handle.

pointers.speaker: Avulstein Gray-Mane
pointers.words: The Battle-Borns. The Emperor's biggest boot-lickers here in Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D6CC4 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: If it's the war you're referring to, I'm on the side of Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:055DFA (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Heimskr
pointers.words: Praise be to Talos, this is a glorious day for Whiterun and for all Skyrim! Our liberators have come at last!

pointers.speaker: Erandur
pointers.words: What an amazing city. I've actually never managed to visit Whiterun, but I always wanted to.

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?

pointers.speaker: Saadia
pointers.words: These men are ruthless. Cunning, deceitful; they'll pay off whoever they can. I can't trust anyone here in Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0562E6 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: A citizen of Whiterun has been kidnapped.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Keep your wits about you. The Jarl of Whiterun is known for his temper.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Now, to prove yourself to me, I have a task for you. Take my axe, and deliver it to the Jarl of Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:05A6B1 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: You can prove your new allegiance to me, by delivering an important message to the Jarl of Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:05A6A6 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: The whole of Whiterun is ripe with paranoia and tensions. The jarl's court is right to fear the power I hold behind this door.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:05BF36 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: I don't much care where it came from or who sent it. What I do know is that it's made the mistake of attacking Whiterun!

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: We have it on good authority that Ulfric has raised enough men to attack the city of Whiterun. The jarl, however, refuses the Legion's support.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C9838 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: There's no question about that. It was a mighty deed. You've earned a place of honor among the heroes of Whiterun.
Help Irileth kill this dragon before it can attack Whiterun. There's no time to lose.
You better get back to Whiterun right away. Jarl Balgruuf will want to know what happened here.
I'm taking command here for the moment. You head back to Whiterun and let the jarl know what happened.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:05DD50 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: I'm proud to be your battle-brother, Dragonborn. Whiterun doesn't need to fear with you on our side.
You saved Whiterun today. We won't forget.
We taught that dragon not to mess with Whiterun, didn't we?
If you want to go out to Whiterun and burn that meadery down, go right ahead.
Didn't you hear the thundering sound as you returned to Whiterun?
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:05EE3F (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Rundi
pointers.words: Another case of mead needs to find its way to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. The delivery fee is yours to keep.

pointers.speaker: Alik'r Warrior
pointers.words: Lead her to the Whiterun stables, outside of the city. We will wait for you there.

pointers.speaker: Mralki
pointers.words: Go and tell Erik that I've changed my mind. I'll see about borrowing some money in Whiterun for his armor.

pointers.speaker: Mralki
pointers.words: Tell Erik that I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor. And please don't hurt me!

pointers.speaker: Mralki
pointers.words: Your kind deed will not go unrewarded, my friend. Tell Erik I've changed my mind, and we'll visit Whiterun soon to fit him for armor.
Oh! There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D083C (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: Tell Delvin that he has my support and all the weight it carries in Whiterun from now on. I think he'll be quite pleased.

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: It's a well-known fact that the steward keeps all of the records on Whiterun's prisoners in a large book.

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: Fortunately, his identity isn't known to the authorities in Whiterun, so there's still a chance to save him.

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: The job is twofold. First, steal a letter that was sent from Solitude warning Whiterun's guard to be on the lookout for Arn.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:07D026 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Esbern
pointers.words: The jarl's palace in Whiterun? Ah, yes... the old story about King Olaf's pet dragon. Ingenious!
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D070F (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Esbern
pointers.words: Very true! I wonder... do you know the jarl's palace in Whiterun?
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:07D427 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: You'll be the toast of Whiterun for this!
I've been thinking of hunting out beyond the boundaries of Whiterun Hold.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:07EBFB (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Alik'r Warrior
pointers.words: You there. We're looking for someone in Whiterun, and will pay good money for information.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:07F3F7 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Mallus Maccius
pointers.words: And guess who gets to run the Black-Briar Meadery in Whiterun? You're looking at him.

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: The Gray-Manes have deep roots in Whiterun, but so do we. Difference is, we're rich... and Vignar hates it.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:084799 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: It's true. Vignar Gray-Mane and his lot are one of Whiterun's oldest and, depending on who you ask, most respected clans. I don't dispute that.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:084798 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Eorlund Gray-Mane
pointers.words: The Skyforge? Aye, my clan-fathers have worked it since the first Gray-Manes came to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Angeline Morrard
pointers.words: No, no. I'm just a simple herbalist. You'll want to see Arcadia, over in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Whiterun seems like a better choice to me. From there we can threaten to undermine the whole Imperial position.

pointers.speaker: Nervous Patron
pointers.words: So you're the... the assassin? I need you to kill the Visiting Noble at Dragonsreach, in Whiterun. Here's the gold. I... I hope it's enough.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: As soon as I get back to Whiterun, I'll get my men ready.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: When I return to Whiterun, I'll get my men ready to help trap this dragon.
I cannot stay. Not here, not in Whiterun. It likely won't be safe for Avulstein, either.
I don't dare return to Whiterun. But my mother... she'll need some consolation.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:08994B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: They'll go looking for me, and Whiterun will be the first place they search.

pointers.speaker: Anoriath
pointers.words: Remember, I've got the freshest meat in all of Whiterun.
There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!

pointers.speaker: Danica Pure-Spring
pointers.words: The goddess' divine blessings have no doubt helped make Whiterun a thriving and prosperous city.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:093137 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Proventus Avenicci
pointers.words: Olaf returned in triumph to Whiterun. By his decree, the city's keep was rebuilt as a prison for Numinex.

pointers.speaker: Proventus Avenicci
pointers.words: The history of Whiterun begins with Jorrvaskr, the hall of the Companions. For a long time, it was the only building on the mountain.
Speak with the Blasphemous Priest at the Temple of Kynareth, in Whiterun. Accept his gold, then kill the target. Hail Sithis!
Well, it's all over now. Lieutenant said you could see the smoke from Whiterun.
Whiterun's walls are tall, but they are old and crumbling, like the Empire whose Legion lines them.
Hah! Who in their right mind would pay for dirt? You'd get laughed out of Whiterun for even trying it.
We've gotten a letter about someone needing some muscle right here in Whiterun Hold.
I've caught wind that one of the brighter Silver Hand has been sniffing around Whiterun.
A group of them has holed up in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Delvin Mallory
pointers.words: We actually got a request from one of the most powerful families in Whiterun, the Battle-Borns.

pointers.speaker: Maven Black-Briar
pointers.words: Head to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun and look for Mallus Maccius. He'll fill you in on all the details.
Then by my right as jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. Congratulations.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0A2C41 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Good day, Lemkil. I saw some nice dresses for your little girls while I was in Whiterun. I'd be happy to purchase them, if you like.
The last time I was in Whiterun, the tradesmen were talking about you. It seems your reputation as a businessman is growing.

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: Ulfric will want to take Whiterun from us. But we will hold fast. We can't give the rebellion free rein through the center of Skyrim.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0A6CB4 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: I can't believe we lost Whiterun. The rebels have a great advantage in controlling the center now. We must take it back!

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: By holding onto Falkreath, we control access to The Reach, Whiterun, and The Rift. Ulfric will try for it soon. We'll be there to stop him.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0A6CB6 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: By taking back Falkreath, we control access to The Reach, Whiterun, and The Rift. We should never have given it up.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0E6C82 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: I fear losing Falkreath may give too much advantage to Ulfric. The rebels now control access to The Reach, Whiterun, and The Rift. I want it back.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0A6CB7 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: We've driven the Imperials out of Whiterun. This is good. Very good. We now control the center. It's a powerful position. One I aim to keep.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: The Imperials have really dug into Whiterun. We'll wrest it from them soon enough. We must. Its central position is key.

pointers.speaker: Arcadia
pointers.words: By helping me, you're helping the good folk of Whiterun. How could I say no to that?
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0AC94D (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Delphine
pointers.words: Or you could catch the carriage from Whiterun to Markarth and then approach from the west.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0ADD73 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Skjor
pointers.words: Here's all you need to know. Jorrvaskr is the oldest building in Whiterun. The Skyforge was here long before it was.

pointers.speaker: Gerdur
pointers.words: It's my mill. Some folks thinks it's my town, too, but it ain't. The jarl in Whiterun owns the land and the town. I just pay the taxes.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0FE2D3 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.quest: Quest to hold aliases and scenes for party
pointers.words: There's every chance I'll return to find a pile of smoking ash where Whiterun once stood.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.quest: Quest to hold aliases and scenes for party
pointers.words: I'd rather be back at Whiterun, but while I'm here I might as well get some real news from the other parts of Skyrim.

pointers.speaker: Proventus Avenicci
pointers.quest: Quest to hold aliases and scenes for party
pointers.words: I am the Steward of Whiterun. I serve Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0BC24D (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: You had best tell the Jarl in Whiterun. He needs to know about this.

pointers.speaker: Mirmulnir
pointers.words: For Whiterun and Skyrim!

pointers.quest: T03- Pilgrim visiting the tree in Whiterun
pointers.words: We are traveling to the Shrine of Kynareth in Whiterun. I hear the Gildergreen is more beautiful than ever since it's been restored.
Well, there might be nothing to it, but I've heard that the feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun has grown ugly.
There were several Khajiit camped outside the walls of Whiterun. Seems they've been traveling around the whole of Skyrim peddling their wares.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: Dammit, woman, I'm the Jarl of Whiterun! I won't apologize for talking to my people. You can't protect me every moment of the day.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C02E3 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Irileth
pointers.words: And if an assassin slips past the night watch, we won't have a jarl at all. Without Balgruuf's leadership, Whiterun will descend into chaos.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C02D8 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Reldith
pointers.words: In Whiterun, mostly. Ennis handles the business arrangements, but I know that he has a few purchasers who give us a fair price.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: I haven't changed my mind, if that's what you're asking. I won't leave Whiterun defenseless, even for a day.

pointers.speaker: Shadr
pointers.words: I was able to work out a deal with the stables in Whiterun to sell me some of their tack and harnesses.
We've been contacted by the Jarl of Whiterun.
And then get back here. Because if Ulfric isn't bluffing, I'll need every able body to defend Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C3472 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ulfberth War-Bear
pointers.words: Vignar the Revered is the jarl in Whiterun. I guess he was a great hero once, because the Companions all call him "Vignar the Revered."
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C6E30 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Carlotta Valentia
pointers.words: You've got no idea. Half the men in Whiterun have proposed to me. Some were even single.

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: Okay, okay. Most of what you said didn't make sense, but you left a note. The only bit I could read said "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C41FE (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: Most of what you said was gibberish, but you left a note. The only bit I could read was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C4204 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: You left a note, but it was mostly gibberish. The only bit I could make out was "after repaying Ysolda in Whiterun."
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0C4206 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Hrongar
pointers.words: Whiterun is the crown jewel of Skyrim, and you would leave us defenseless?

pointers.speaker: Oengul War-Anvil
pointers.words: Every bit as sharp as what you'll find in Whiterun.
One group has hidden out in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: Get those documents to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: To Whiterun with you.

pointers.speaker: Carlotta Valentia
pointers.words: I can take care of myself. A Whiterun woman learns how to handle a few idiot men early in life.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: In honor of your service in battle, I am hereby granting you permission to purchase property in Whiterun. Talk to my steward if you're interested.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CB1B7 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Fralia Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Gray-Mane. Now that's a name fills you with pride. We've got roots in Whiterun. We've got history.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CBAAE (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: It'd be my honor should you decide to make Whiterun your home. Speak with Proventus. He'll make the necessary arrangements.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: For Whiterun! For the Empire!

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: But there's no shame in it. One of them dragons comes callin' in Whiterun, the place'll go up like tinder.

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: Best head up to Dragonsreach, then, and see the jarl. He's lord of Whiterun, and can set you on the path.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CD074 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: You need only ask about it. Plenty o' folk in Whiterun with too much fat and gold to be bothered doing anything for themselves.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CD077 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: Well met, kinsman. What brings you to Whiterun?
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CD078 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: Well met, traveler. What brings you to Whiterun?
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0CD079 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: The citizens of Whiterun are forever in your debt!

pointers.speaker: Idolaf Battle-Born
pointers.words: New in town, huh? Whiterun's got two clans, both old and both respected.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: Well done. You sought me out, on your own initiative. You've done Whiterun a service, and I won't forget it.
Or else what? You think you can stand against the entire Whiterun city guard? The gate's closed.
Welcome to Whiterun, friend. Go right on in.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D197B (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Alvor
pointers.words: We need to get word to Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun to send whatever soldiers he can. If you'll do that for me, I'll be in your debt.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D2327 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Then... Whiterun will stand with you, Dragonborn. We will take the risk, and gain the glory, whether it be in victory or defeat!
Never been to Whiterun before? The jarl's palace is something to see. Dragonsreach they call it. Big old dragon skull hanging on the wall.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0DD656 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: When I'm in Whiterun, I always visit the Gildergreen. Never hurts to pay your respects to Lady Kynareth, particularly in my line of work.
Oh, there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D2A50 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: I bet you'll be glad to get to Whiterun and get out of this weather.
Jarl Balgruuf? He rules Whiterun Hold. A good man, perhaps a bit overcautious, but these are dangerous times.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D39B8 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Succeed at this, and you'll be rewarded. Whiterun will be in your debt.
Call it whatever you like, General. The man's going to try to take Whiterun.
I'm telling you, Ulfric's planning an attack on Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: We have it on good authority that Ulfric has raised enough men to attack the city of Whiterun. The jarl, however, refuses the Legion's support.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D660D (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: I need someone I can trust to deliver a message of great import to Jarl Balgruuf of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: General Tullius
pointers.words: I need someone I can trust to deliver a message of great import to Jarl Hrongar of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Eorlund Gray-Mane
pointers.words: The Companions are the oldest, most honored band of warriors in Skyrim. Whiterun was built around their hall, Jorrvaskr.
Of course. You already saved Whiterun from that dragon. I owe you a great deal.

pointers.speaker: Maurice Jondrelle
pointers.words: You should take it to Whiterun. Danica will want to see that the true blessings of nature lie in renewal, not a slavish maintenance.

pointers.speaker: Danica Pure-Spring
pointers.words: This is the Temple of Kynareth. The Gildergreen, outside, was planted as a seedling in the early years of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Danica Pure-Spring
pointers.words: This is the Gildergreen. It was planted as a seedling in the early years of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Mallus Maccius
pointers.words: How could I complain when I went from Sabjorn's lackey to one of the wealthiest merchants in Whiterun in no time at all?

pointers.speaker: Mallus Maccius
pointers.words: What brings you to Whiterun? Got some juicy goods to sell?
I'd take this a bit more seriously, if I were you. If a dragon decides to attack Whiterun I don't know if we can stop it.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0D8B71 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: I expect a great deal of excitement in the city of Whiterun in the near future...
Proventus, what do you make of all this? If Ulfric were to attack Whiterun...

pointers.speaker: Aela the Huntress
pointers.words: It means resting your haunches in Whiterun more than I'd care to, for one.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0DAB44 (Narrative Gameplay Consistent Dialogue Tweaks.esp)

pointers.speaker: Spectral Assassin
pointers.words: Whiterun, home of the Skyforge. It is said a blade forged in its fires can cut through sinew as if it were parchment.
Morthal, capital of Hjaalmarch hold. Not quite in the same league as Solitude or Whiterun, but a nice enough place if you like swamps.

pointers.speaker: Gerdur
pointers.words: We need to get word to Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun to send whatever troops he can. If you'll do that for me, I'll be in your debt.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0DF01D (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Delvin Mallory
pointers.words: Thanks to Maven Black-Briar, we still have some pull in Riften. But get arrested in Whiterun and you'll be tossed right into the prisons.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0DF04C (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Jarl Balgruuf? I don't mean to be disrespectful, as he's ruled Whiterun Hold well for years, but he seems in over his head now.
By my right as jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. It's the greatest honor that's within my power to grant.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0E0EB8 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Hrongar
pointers.words: So my brother really did it. Whiterun will be the toast of Skyrim for this!
Things hinge on Whiterun. If we can take the city without bloodshed all the better. But if not...
Don't be so sure of that. We've intercepted couriers from Solitude. The Empire's putting a great deal of pressure on Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Amren
pointers.words: I tracked it to a group of bandits nearby. But I'm no fool. I'd need the Whiterun guards or maybe hire the Companions to get it.

pointers.speaker: Farkas
pointers.words: Travelers have been coming to Whiterun. They tell stories about dragons.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: I'm glad you're here. I have a message I need delivered to the Jarl of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: I'm glad you're here. I have a message I need delivered to the Jarl of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Brill
pointers.words: But remember, Whiterun is home to the Companions. Any dragon that comes here will get more than he's bargained for, I think.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: We've got an old saying -- the Gray-Manes have lived in Whiterun since the first snows fell in Skyrim.

pointers.speaker: Ulfric Stormcloak
pointers.words: Make haste to our camp in Whiterun. I want you on the front lines.
Send the word. "A new day is dawning and the sun rises over Whiterun."
Whiterun's army will no doubt be bolstered with Legionnaires. And those walls around Whiterun are old, but they still stand.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0E409E (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Whiterun is only a means to an end.
Give the word, my lord, and Whiterun is yours.

pointers.speaker: Angeline Morrard
pointers.words: My daughter, Fura, was assigned to Whiterun after she joined the Imperial army. I was hoping you might have met her.
pointers.record: INFO Skyrim.esm:0E8BCC (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.speaker: Angeline Morrard
pointers.words: You're a traveller, correct? Have you been to Whiterun?

pointers.speaker: Delphine
pointers.words: We heard the news from Whiterun - that you left the city on the back of a dragon!
You have quite the bounty on your head in Whiterun. You pay me, and I see that your name is cleared.
Just fine. Whiterun is a lovely city, and there are so many other children here - they all love playing together.
pointers.record: INFO HearthFires.esm:008926 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: Couldn't be better. Whiterun is perfect for a child - great weather, plenty of space, friends to play with. What more could you want?
pointers.record: INFO HearthFires.esm:00892C (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

pointers.words: You know Belethor's shop in Whiterun? That'd be a good place to start. He carries all sorts of things like that.
The land is near Giants' Gap, right on the border with Whiterun Hold. You'll almost be in sight of the Loreius Farm, in fact.
Yes, it is. It's in the southern part of The Pale, right on the border with Whiterun Hold. All the room in the world to build your own house.

pointers.speaker: Lydia
pointers.words: For Whiterun!

pointers.speaker: Teldryn Sero
pointers.words: Whiterun... the pride of Skyrim. Doesn't look like much to me. Now Blacklight on the other hand, that's a proper city.

pointers.speaker: Teldryn Sero
pointers.words: Anyway, we'd just cleared a ruined fort somewhere outside of Whiterun and when we got outside, we saw one of them galloping away on horseback.

pointers.speaker: Gore
pointers.words: A Redguard woman in Whiterun, scar on her cheek... I don't remember seeing anyone like that here. I'm usually pretty drunk whenever we stop in Whiterun, though.
Whiterun's infrastructure is... neglected. At best.

pointers.speaker: Gore
pointers.words: Agreed. There's a bar in Whiterun called the "Drunken Huntsman." Heard it's one of the few places in Skyrim where you can get a drink without some milk drinking bard wailing away in your ear.
Well, what do you think of Whiterun?
That thing's headed toward Whiterun... Riverwood...

pointers.speaker: Gulvar
pointers.words: Well, it's a sad one, but I don't mind telling it. Name's Gulvar. I'm a farmer, always was. Grew up on a farm near Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Gulvar
pointers.words: That was the first time in five generations my family started locking its doors at night. We knew the guards from Whiterun weren't going to help us.

pointers.speaker: Theodyn Bienne
pointers.words: You'd best head on over to The Bannered Mare in Whiterun. Speak to Lurius Liore. He mentioned something about trouble with a dragon.

pointers.speaker: Initiate Valrar
pointers.words: One of my favored duties is providing healing to the sick. I visit the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun when I can.

pointers.speaker: Aradil
pointers.words: That fetcher has himself locked up in a jail cell in Whiterun. You can find your 'friend' there.

pointers.speaker: Aradil
pointers.words: He's in jail in Whiterun. Find him there if you care that much.

pointers.speaker: Aradil
pointers.words: Well, if you're looking to exact justice, you needn't bother. He's in a cell in Whiterun jail.

pointers.speaker: Paladin Asger
pointers.words: I lived in Whiterun for a time. Tried out for the Companions. Wasn't for me.

pointers.speaker: Arch-Paladin Laracin
pointers.words: Whiterun certainly displays the best aspects of Skyrim.

pointers.speaker: Paladin Marith
pointers.words: I like Whiterun. Something about it just feels... Homely.

pointers.speaker: Initiate Valrar
pointers.words: It was a mutual agreement. Making the journey between the Sanctum, Riverwood and Whiterun just didn't leave us with much time.
A priest of Arkay in Whiterun has requested our assistance. It seems they have some problems with a vampire.

pointers.speaker: Elenwen
pointers.quest: Quest to hold aliases and scenes for party
pointers.words: My colleagues spoke of your victories against the rebels. Your valor at the Battle of Whiterun was particularly noteworthy.

pointers.speaker: Elenwen
pointers.quest: Quest to hold aliases and scenes for party
pointers.words: My colleagues spoke of your exploits in the Civil War. Your valor at the Battle of Whiterun was particularly noteworthy.
It has come to my attention that Jarl Balgruuf of Whiterun may yet harbor heretical beliefs.
It has come to my attention that Jarl Hrongar of Whiterun may yet harbor heretical beliefs.
The White-Gold Concordat grants you entry into Whiterun. However, this investigation falls under Thalmor jurisdiction. The Legion will not intervene.
This is my first time back in Whiterun since the unfortunate incident with my former patron. Quite sad when I think about it.
pointers.record: INFO Extended Hireling Dialogue Teldryn.esp:0009A1 (Extended Hireling Dialogue Teldryn.esp)

pointers.words: You think a city named Whiterun would have more snow, eh? False advertising, I say.
pointers.record: INFO Extended Hireling Dialogue Teldryn.esp:00083D (Extended Hireling Dialogue Teldryn.esp)

pointers.speaker: Auri
pointers.words: I heard there's a sacred tree in Whiterun. Can we go see the sacred tree? Please?

pointers.speaker: Auri
pointers.words: Ah, Whiterun. The city of playing children, fresh-baked bread and shrieking fundamentalists.

pointers.speaker: Auri
pointers.words: Whiterun is pretty bare as far as cities go, but it does have a rather welcoming atmosphere, doesn't it?
Jon is but one man in Whiterun, and Whiterun is just one city in Skyrim. There's still so much out there... why grieve over a man who never cared?
You mean... I can get away from all the issues in Whiterun and go see the world out there?
Let's talk to Uncle Vignar about capturing this dragon. You helped him win Whiterun's throne. Now, it's his turn to repay this debt.
There was a clown in Whiterun some years back... But Balgruuf kicked him off the Cloud District after watching just one performance.
So, Cicero is spared? Nice. Maybe he'll bring his circus to Whiterun one day and run Nazeem out of business.
Cicero is dead. I say we put his clothes to good use and dress Nazeem with it when we get back to Whiterun.
Raven Rock's barely a town compared to Whiterun, but its politics is ten times more dense. Sounds like the elves just can't live without drama.
Whiterun's walls used to seem so unreachable. But those stones weren't what truly confined me.
My clan helped build these walls, you know. Thanks to my ancestors, Whiterun repelled hundreds of sieges.
Whiterun's people can be dependable, but all the more often they're stubborn to the bones. Myself included.
One good thing about Riften? It teaches me to appreciate those who clean Whiterun's sewers.
I'm glad my ancestors chose Whiterun. At least we grew up to be warriors instead of pickpockets.
Solstheim is the farthest one can get from Whiterun, I'd imagine. Everything here is just so... different.
I should find something exotic to bring home to Whiterun. My Ma's going to love a souvenir or two.
There are plenty of giants on Whiterun Hold's plains, but we mostly just leave them alone. I'd advise you to do the same.
And now, here I am - a strong Nord woman, trained by two of Whiterun's best.
Hulda's the best boss in Whiterun. She pays fairly and isn't afraid to throw a rowdy drunk out on their ear if they harass her staff.
Hulda was the best boss in Whiterun. She paid fairly and wasn't afraid to throw a rowdy drunk out on their ear if they harassed her staff.
This ain't the place for you, Olfina. Get back to Whiterun, I'll rescue Thorald!
I don't see many war refugees in Whiterun. Not from Hammerfell, at least.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: A message to Whiterun, my own city... Destiny calls.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: War is upon Whiterun... Our ideal will be tested, but we must not falter - for we fight not just for a city, but also our people's freedom.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Whiterun is finally ours - truly ours! We can live freely with no Imperial taxman or Thalmor spy to spit on our traditions.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Whiterun still bears the scars of the siege. People often fear change... but clinging to the past won't heal the walls.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: As long as the Empire remains in Skyrim, Whiterun will not see true peace... That'll change when we cast the Legion back to Cyrodiil.

pointers.speaker: Olfina Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Balgruuf is wise to side with the children of Skyrim. Whiterun needs its people more than it needs the Empire.

pointers.speaker: Jon Battle-Born
pointers.words: I wish she and I could go to the Bards College together, but my parents need me in Whiterun.
Then send out the footmen! I don't care how it's done. Nothing taken from Whiterun's lands will reach Imperial hands.
You aren't a big fan of Whiterun's guards, I take it.
Those whelps won't last a minute against a real bandit raid. Such a shame, to think Whiterun got its name from our warrior tradition.
Whiterun needs a storm to clear the rot. A Jarl with fire in his belly, and a captain who remembers how to hold a shield, not just a tankard.
Finally made it to Guard Captain, Sinmir. You must have lots of ideas to change Whiterun.
Change is a hard road, but this city finally has protectors worthy of its walls. Under your uncle's command, Whiterun will find its strength again.
Whiterun is nice enough. The air is good. I always feel exposed here though.  So much flat land all around. Many eyes watch this town.
Whiterun is quite lovely.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: I will never forget fighting that dragon outside Whiterun. It was exhilarating and terrifying in equal measure.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: That meadery in Whiterun had a major pest problem. The evil wizard in the basement wasn't helping matters either. You should have been paid extra.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: You lead the Companions now, yes? Maybe you could make bathing mandatory. Whiterun smells like sweaty dogs to me.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: Whiterun owes you a debt, I think. That lovely, big, nice smelling tree almost completely masks the local canine odour now that it's healthy again.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: Whiterun has some of the best air in Skyrim. There is a subtle dog breath aftertaste though.
I saw you terrifying the town of Whiterun. You were not yourself. You were unrecognizable and very angry.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: I wonder if the Jarl of Whiterun knows he has giant lizard problem. If not, he may reward us for the information.

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: We should probably drop that Dragonstone off in Whiterun as soon as possible. I have a horrible feeling it attracts the undead.

pointers.speaker: Nazeem
pointers.words: Are you trying to make Whiterun smell like the wilderness? Go on, cover up. We do have standards here.
pointers.record: INFO Naked Comments Overhaul.esp:000901 (Naked Comments Overhaul.esp)

pointers.speaker: Nazeem
pointers.words: This is Whiterun, not Black Marsh. Show a little decorum, won't you?
pointers.record: INFO Naked Comments Overhaul.esp:000902 (Naked Comments Overhaul.esp)

pointers.speaker: Nazeem
pointers.words: I expected more sophistication from an Imperial. You're embarrassing yourself and Whiterun.
pointers.record: INFO Naked Comments Overhaul.esp:000904 (Naked Comments Overhaul.esp)

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: You disrespect the Jarl of Whiterun in this way?!
pointers.record: INFO Collision Dialogue Overhaul.esp:0009A6 (Collision Dialogue Overhaul.esp)

pointers.words: The road to Whiterun's not safe these days. Lots of travelers just.. disappear, south of Dragon Bridge. Can't find a trace of them.

pointers.speaker: Narri
pointers.words: There was an attack on Jorrvaskr in Whiterun. Kodlak Whitemane has been killed! May his soul live forever in the halls of Sovngarde.

pointers.speaker: Erik the Slayer
pointers.words: You had best tell the Jarl in Whiterun. He needs to know about this.

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: This is the Gildergreen. It's part of the Temple of Kynareth. They say it was planted as a seedling in the early years of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Delvin Mallory
pointers.words: Get arrested in Whiterun and you'll be tossed right into the prisons. But thanks to Maven Black-Briar, we still have some pull in Riften.

pointers.speaker: Hadvar
pointers.words: I'd recommend heading to Whiterun, just down the road from here. From there you can take a carriage to Solitude.

pointers.speaker: Ralof
pointers.words: Just head north - you can't miss it. It's the capital of Whiterun Hold.

pointers.speaker: Gerdur
pointers.words: Cross the river and then head north. You'll see Whiterun on its hill as you pass the falls.

pointers.speaker: Sven
pointers.words: You had best tell the Jarl in Whiterun. He needs to know about this.

pointers.speaker: Jouane Manette
pointers.words: Dragonborn. The last time I was in Whiterun, the tradesmen were talking about you. It seems your reputation is growing.

pointers.speaker: Erik
pointers.words: Oh there once was a hero named Erik Hoepusher... who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!

pointers.speaker: Mralki
pointers.words: Oh there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!

pointers.speaker: Erik the Slayer
pointers.words: Oh, there once was a hero named Erik Hoepusher, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead! Hmm, I think it works.

pointers.speaker: Mralki
pointers.words: No, no. That's the Jarl in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Ennis
pointers.words: I visit Whiterun from time to time, mostly to make deals.

pointers.speaker: Belethor
pointers.words: Well, there might be nothing to it, but I've heard that the feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun has grown ugly.

pointers.speaker: Jenassa
pointers.words: You better get back to Whiterun right away. Jarl Balgruuf will want to know what happened here.

pointers.speaker: Adrianne Avenicci
pointers.words: I don't claim to be the best blacksmith in Whiterun. Eorlund Gray-Mane's got that honor. Man's steel is legendary. All I ask is a fair chance.

pointers.speaker: Adrianne Avenicci
pointers.words: I don't claim to be the best blacksmith in Whiterun. Eorlund Gray-Mane was that and more, but now he's dead. All I ask is a fair chance.

pointers.speaker: Bergritte Battle-Born
pointers.words: The feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun has grown ugly.

pointers.speaker: Hulda
pointers.words: The city's changed, friend. The Thieves Guild is on the rise... and they've got a firm foothold here in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Andurs
pointers.words: As Whiterun's priest of Arkay, I spread his word whenever I'm able. In the meantime, most of my hours are spent with the city's dearly departed.

pointers.speaker: Commander Caius
pointers.words: I'm the commander of the guard here in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Sinmir
pointers.words: The security in Whiterun is terrible. Shameful, is what it is.

pointers.speaker: Anoriath
pointers.words: Do you hunt? The plains outside Whiterun are ripe with game.

pointers.speaker: Adrianne Avenicci
pointers.words: Ulfrics going to try to take Whiterun. But Balgruuf refuses the Legion's right to garrison troops in his city.

pointers.speaker: Olfrid Battle-Born
pointers.words: I hope the Empire is sending reinforcements to drive these heathens out of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Whiterun once again belongs to its rightful heirs. It's a glorious day for Skyrim.

pointers.speaker: Idolaf Battle-Born
pointers.words: How could Whiterun fall into the hands of these stinking half-wit Nords? Has the Empire forsaken us?

pointers.speaker: Nimriel
pointers.words: Whatever you do, stay away from that Khajiit caravan camped outside the walls of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Nimriel
pointers.words: Look, shadowy figures are being seen coming in and out of Whiterun. And, a lot of Khajiit turn to thievery to get by.

pointers.speaker: Gwendolyn
pointers.words: I work for the only family left that truly cares what happens to Whiterun. The Battle-Borns.

pointers.speaker: Bjorlam
pointers.words: When I'm in Whiterun, I always visit the Gildergreen. Never hurts to pay your respects to Lady Kynareth, particularly in my line of work.

pointers.speaker: Hjornskar Head-Smasher
pointers.words: Sadly, we can't risk attacking now. The skirmishes have been violent here in Whiterun. My men are stretched thin as it is, so we'll bide our time.

pointers.speaker: Hjornskar Head-Smasher
pointers.words: Whiterun is the crown jewel of Skyrim, and it belongs to the true Sons of Skyrim now.

pointers.speaker: Hjornskar Head-Smasher
pointers.words: I don't know about such things, but rest assured, Whiterun will stand with the Stormcloaks, one way or another.

pointers.speaker: Balgruuf the Greater
pointers.words: Damn it, I'm the Jarl of Whiterun. I've got war lurking just outside my gates.

pointers.speaker: Proventus Avenicci
pointers.words: I only counsel caution. There's a feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun, for example.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Skyrim needs a High King who will fight for her, and Whiterun needs a Jarl who will do the same.

pointers.speaker: Bjorlam
pointers.words: I might have to stop and get myself a pint of mead while I'm in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Athis
pointers.words: I swear, every wanderer who shows up in Whiterun looks weaker than the last.

pointers.speaker: Lydia
pointers.words: This war has taken a toll on Skyrim. I just hope it never comes to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Lydia
pointers.words: Skyrim's courts have become dangerous of late. And Whiterun is definitely not an exception.

pointers.speaker: Haran
pointers.words: We may not have as much to offer as Whiterun or Solitude, but we'll do what we can to make your stay a pleasant one.

pointers.speaker: Birna
pointers.words: By the gods, it's true, isn't it? A dragon has attacked Whiterun. How could mere men bring down such a beast?

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: That sapling you recovered means the Gildergreen will live again. Your deed honors the people of Whiterun, and all of Skyrim.

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: The people of Whiterun know your true worth. If only visitors to Riften were as noble.

pointers.speaker: Mjoll the Lioness
pointers.words: The Gods' blessings have no doubt helped make Whiterun a thriving and prosperous city.

pointers.speaker: Marcurio
pointers.words: Whiterun is a lovely city. I think we should take a load off and enjoy the atmosphere.

pointers.speaker: Marcurio
pointers.words: Do you know Belethor's shop in Whiterun? He carries all sorts of things. It's a good store.

pointers.speaker: Marcurio
pointers.words: I've heard that the feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun has grown ugly.

pointers.speaker: Hillevi Cruel-Sea
pointers.words: Get Skyrim's freshest fruit and vegetables here! None of that Whiterun slop!
pointers.record: INFO Shouts of Stallholders.esp:00083E (Shouts of Stallholders.esp)

pointers.speaker: Reldith
pointers.words: Yes, speak to the Jarl. You'd get laughed out of Whiterun for even trying it.
Cause trouble in Whiterun, and I'll haul you into the Dragonsreach dungeon myself.
pointers.record: INFO Guard Dialogue Overhaul.esp:014B68 (Guard Dialogue Overhaul.esp)

pointers.words: You're headed to Whiterun. Here, take this.
There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
Never been to Whiterun before? The Jarl's palace is something to see. Big old dragon skull hanging on the wall. Impressive.
Whiterun belongs to the true Sons of Skyrim now. Just as it should.
pointers.record: INFO Civil War Lines Expansion.esp:0008DD (Civil War Lines Expansion.esp)

pointers.words: The road to Whiterun is not safe these days. Stay sharp.
pointers.record: INFO Civil War Lines Expansion.esp:000913 (Civil War Lines Expansion.esp)

pointers.words: Gods! The battle for Whiterun was a triumph the bards will sing of for ages! I've never gained such glory...

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Anyway, let's get back to Whiterun. I... I need to cool down after this whole ordeal.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Anyway, let's get back to Whiterun. I... I need to cool down after this whole ordeal.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Anyway, let's get back to Whiterun. I... I need to cool down after this whole ordeal.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Come on! We can figure this whole thing later. Let's get back to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Forget I said anything. Let's get back to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Erik the Slayer
pointers.words: No. Well, I've been to Whiterun a few times, but it was always while accompanying my father.

pointers.speaker: Avulstein Gray-Mane
pointers.words: I'm planning to stay here in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Avulstein Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Today is the day we set Whiterun free.

pointers.speaker: Avulstein Gray-Mane
pointers.words: For Whiterun! For the Gray-Manes!

pointers.speaker: Avulstein Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Die, Imperial! You won't taint Whiterun further!
I won't tolerate their presence in Whiterun Hold. I trust you to know what must be done.

pointers.speaker: Thorald Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Well, Windhelm's emblem is the bear, and Whiterun's is the steed. At least that's what I think.
Leaving again? Why? Whiterun is under the Stormcloaks' rule. You are surrounded by friends here.

pointers.speaker: Geirlund
pointers.words: The Jarl of Whiterun has assigned me as Avulstein's housecarl. It's my pride to guard his line.
Whiterun's people never had to worry for hunger... and so neither need we.
Whiterun's hunters have their eyes on the tundra's game... and we have ours on the city's.
Whiterun is the city of trade. You can find all sorts of things in its markets.
Used to be you can find mead from smaller brands in Whiterun. Good quality too. Now it's all overtaken by the Honningbrew nonsense.
Seems like there's starting to be more Black-Briar Mead in Whiterun. Good for them.
The bards told me that Whiterun got its name from the White River nearby. I wonder how the mead made with its water tastes?
Besides, all my old drinking buddies from Whiterun felt wrong in the gut after drinking it. Who knows if their operation is even clean?
Whiterun is the center of Skyrim, and that draws many adventurers like us here.
Believe it or not, my first sword was forged in Whiterun. Shame I lost it though.
I thought Riften was the worst of it. But Whiterun? Their guards stood by while bandits strolled in and killed a Companion! That cannot be forgiven.
No matter how long I've lived in Whiterun for, the wilds will always be my home.
Jorrvaskr is the only sight worth beholding in Whiterun.
Athis may not look like it, but he's the best swordsman around Whiterun.
All this time I've lived in Whiterun, I've never thought we'd actually capture a dragon here.
For the Jarl of Whiterun to agree to capturing the dragon, huh?
Just wondering how Whiterun's people will think of the Companions if they ever learned the truth.
She only came to Whiterun some months ago, shrouded in mystery and all.
All this time I've lived in Whiterun, there's always been an eeriness I smelled in the air. Now I know where it came from.
Then I climed to the bandit chief's tower, and saw five hostages - all guards of Whiterun.
The Gildergreen is dying, and so is part of Whiterun with it... Nature fades here, and it needs its strength restored. Let's find this Nettlebane.
The Gildergreen will bloom again, and Whiterun grow strong with it. The Eldergleam... will survive, as will we, under Hircine's watchful eye.
A new Gildergreen will bloom, and Whiterun grow strong with it. The wilds thrive, and so do we, under Hircine's watchful eye.
Jorrvaskr's become quieter without Kodlak. Though I still feel his presence sometimes, watching over Whiterun.
There are a few redguard women in Whiterun. We have Saffir, who always keeps to herself and her books. Could be hiding something.
Don't know any other Redguard women from Whiterun.
But it's freezing! Can't we swim somewhere warmer? Like Whiterun?
The Jarl of Whiterun freely offers us a bit of coin, as do those whom we help, so that we may continue aiding the people in need.
Jorrvaskr is the oldest building in Whiterun. It was placed here because of the Skyforge, which is even older - though no one knows by how much.
But look at this - for some bandits to breach Whiterun's walls and assault Jorrvaskr, they must have planned this for months.
So, the undead have indeed risen in the middle of Whiterun? If we hadn't come here, their curse would spread to the rest of the city.
Words of Dawnstar's nightmares have reached even Whiterun, but this doesn't seem like something we can handle with our steel.
Is this true? Ysolda in Whiterun is dealing with this sap - knowing well it's no different to skooma, if not worse?
But either way, I'll be keeping an eye on Ysolda. Any move she makes that destroy more lives, and Whiterun's guards will be the least of her problem.
A few years before you joined, several brutal murders happened near Whiterun. The victims had their bodies mauled and scattered about...

pointers.words: Maybe Whiterun would see the monsters they were, drive them to the wilds like Kodlak did to me.
pointers.record: INFO FDE Aela Part 2.esp:0009E4 (FDE Aela Part 2.esp)

pointers.words: All it takes is one botched transition, and all of Whiterun will see what I want them to see.
pointers.record: INFO FDE Aela Part 2.esp:0009F1 (FDE Aela Part 2.esp)

pointers.words: Long as Jorrvaskr stands, Arnbjorn will never be allowed near Whiterun and its people.
pointers.record: INFO FDE Aela Part 2.esp:000AD4 (FDE Aela Part 2.esp)

pointers.words: I agree. But Kodlak forbade us. Said no blood shall be spilled unless he returned to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Brelyna Maryon
pointers.words: I never grow tired of the bustling market of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Brelyna Maryon
pointers.words: Whiterun is not just the wealthiest city of Skyrim. It's also the cleanest.
Whiterun, the fabled city of the Companions. I would surely like to meet them.
I've only been to Whiterun a few times before I joined you. I can't believe that I found it exotic at the time!
I've always longed for Whiterun when I was a boy, savoring any chance I got to come here.
Before I came to Riverwood, I never thought Whiterun Hold had anything outside the tundra. This is truly a beautiful place.
Whiterun, the home of Jorrvaskr and the Companions... These ancient stones, almost brought to ruin because of this war.
Whiterun respects strength more than others realize.
Mor Khazgur seldom received traders from Whiterun, yet I've heard all about it.
Others see Whiterun as a trading hub. I see Whiterun as a home to warriors.
I can smell this city's stench all the way from Whiterun.
I'll be happy to stay here when we aren't adventuring together. There are a few ways that my knowledge could help Whiterun.
They say Whiterun is the economic center of Skyrim. I wonder why.
What kind of meadery has a mad wizard and dozens of infested skeevers in its tunnels? Has no one in Whiterun paid a mind on public health?
I'm surprised they even sell this swill in Whiterun. Honningbrew doesn't hold a candle to Black-Briar Mead.
Now that you are the Harbinger of the Companions, maybe the Guild will have an easy time in Whiterun.
There's gold to be made and gems to be pocketed in Whiterun, if you know where to look.
Whiterun sits on a mountain of gold. Surely, it won't miss a few exquisite gems...
This town may be a good place to lay low in after we pull off a heist in Whiterun.
Whiterun has become a refuge for many who sought to escape Hammerfell's wars.
Whiterun's market sells goods from across the continent. Perhaps I may find something to remind me of Hammerfell.
The Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns' bickering only weakens Whiterun when the real fight arrives.
Whiterun hides behind its illusion of safety, but its walls will one day crumble.
For all its wealth, Whiterun does not have much taste in art.
Whiterun's bustling market is the perfect place for an assassin to blend in with the crowd and strike.
Whiterun's Jarl believed he could contain this power, but perhaps it was meant to be unleashed.
White River Watch's location allows the bandits to easily ambush the caravans that travel between Whiterun and Windhelm.
The East Empire Company used to run caravans between Whiterun and Windhelm. That ceased to be when the bandits took over the region.
Whiterun hides behind its illusion of safety, yet the threats beyond the walls' confines will break this mirage.
It's said that one can find any of Skyrim's curiosity in Whiterun's market.
All of Whiterun is setting its gaze at that watchtower and the battle that'll take place there.
The day you found me in Whiterun set my life back on the right path, and I will never trade that for anything.
The Silver Hand marched into Whiterun as if no one were there. As I have always known - Whiterun's walls are just there for show.
If you ask me, either Whiterun's guards were bribed by the Silver Hand, or they were in on it.
Now that the Silver Hand are done... Perhaps we should return to Whiterun and pay the old warrior our final respects - for what mine is worth to him.
Morthal stands between Solitude and Whiterun, yet it barely receives visitors or caravans. There are many good reasons for that.
The Battle-Borns and the Gray-Manes are two of Whiterun's great clans.
There is a Redguard woman in the Bannered Mare. She's a newcomer in Whiterun, just as I am. That could be the one those Alik'r are looking for.
They say the Gildergreen brings prosperity to Whiterun. That sounds like superstitious nonsense - the walls and the commerce are what make it thrive.
Whiterun blooms with business. Any soul competent enough can make a living here.
Whiterun's gold flows like a river - in mere weeks I've earned what I did in other cities through seasons.
There are many kids in Whiterun. Our children must know how to defend themselves from bullies.
pointers.record: INFO FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp:000861 (FDE Jenassa Part 2.esp)

pointers.words: Once upon a time, in the quiet little town of Whiterun, there lived a maiden called Uthgerd, nicknamed "the broken".
In a few months' time, I became stronger than all the kids in Whiterun. I might still be sick... but I wasn't letting that get in my way anymore.
We should avenge Kodlak White-Mane and show those Silver Hands what Whiterun's warriors are made of.
Whiterun may not look like it, but it respects strength just as any city in Skyrim.
People gain their fortune in Whiterun. I wonder if you'll gain yours here?
They were teaching her to be a weakling to be picked on. If it wasn't for me, she would've been eaten alive by Whiterun.
When the kids of Whiterun ganged up on me, he would always watch from a distance. Never to join them, and never to help me. He just laughed.
He watched my suffering. Now the whole Whiterun watches his.
I can't believe that I once took the Companions' rejection as a shame, when you Companions are the real shame of Whiterun.
I passed through Karthspire when I made my way to Whiterun. Believe me - there are Forsworn, then there are the maniacs of this place.
Whiterun has a dragon trap? It seems I chose a far more interesting refuge than I originally expected.
Thank the gods Jorrvaskr has its own mead. The last thing Whiterun needs is the Companions starting a drunken brawl at the Bannered Mare.
Whiterun was not my first choice for a refuge - but gods willing, this just might be my new home.
I suppose that should be comforting. You've proven more reliable than all of Whiterun's guards, if anything.
They say you can see Dragonsreach from every vantage point in Whiterun Hold, just as the White-Gold Tower is visible everywhere down south.
Whiterun is the center of Skyrim. That makes it the city of opportunities.
Honestly, Whiterun is better than Riften in every perceivable way. And unlike Riften, the people in Whiterun can actually afford my Tree Sap.
Why, it's the one place everyone in Whiterun goes to. One would say it's the best place to... distribute something.
I have a blooming business in Whiterun. I stand to make more coins than my parents ever did.
A living captured dragon. Oh, imagine the wonders it would've done to Whiterun's tourism...
This is a far cry from Whiterun, I'll give you that.
Whiterun has been my home for as long as I'd like to remember.
Whiterun is the center of Skyrim. That brings all sorts of people - and customers - to my products.
So many people pass through Whiterun, and so many happy customers who kept coming back for my Tree Sap.
If I told you how many people in Whiterun are my loyal customers, you'd be shocked.
At this point, I almost have as much sway as a Thane on Whiterun's affairs, thanks to the Tree Sap.
Belethor fashions himself as Whiterun's most soulless merchant. That title suits him fine.
He's an insufferable soul, wandering around Whiterun just to tell everyone how great he is.
Such a shame that Delphine is leaving the inn to Orgnar. I might have to go all the way to Whiterun for a decent inn from now on.
I thought Cyrodiil's guards were lousy enough, but Whiterun's guards just let some bandits barge into the city and pick fights with the Companions!
I seldom traveled to Whiterun. Riverwood has got all I needed.
Whiterun is the center of Skyrim, and the city reflects that in many ways.
Camilla's brother would sometimes travel to Whiterun to negotiate deals. That's when I could get some alone time with her.
Helping repair Whiterun's tree ought to be repentence enough for a woodcutter.
Whiterun has changed so much since the first time I came here.
You can find almost all sorts of things in Whiterun, except quality food.
Whiterun may not have the grandeur of Skingrad, but of the cities I've ever traveled to, its people are certainly the happiest.
I should feel so fortunate that the giants near Whiterun hadn't taken an interest in Riverwood yet.
I saw the Gildergreen before while in Whiterun for business. The tree could use more watering and better soil, I'll give you that.
Whiterun is a great place to settle in. So many people to talk to, and the city seems prosperous enough.
Our kids are loving Whiterun. There's just so much to see.
Our child is loving Whiterun. There are so many kids to play with.
I took a carriage back to Whiterun. Too worn out from days of walking.
I wasn't always the swordswoman that I am. But with experience, I am now worthy enough to travel alongside the Thane of Whiterun.
Whiterun's my home, whatever people say about it.
Whiterun may not be the most impressive city in Skyrim, but it'll always be the strongest and greatest.
Solitude stands tall, but it's no Whiterun.
I prefer Whiterun's weather over Solitude's.
Windhelm may be Skyrim's oldest city, but it'll never be its most prosperous as long as Whiterun remains.
With its imposing stature, Windhelm will never have the same sense of home as Whiterun.
The bandits tried to attack Whiterun a few times. Fortunately, the guards were always able to fend them off.
I guess this island is as far away from Whiterun as can be.
Let's make Whiterun proud.
For as long as I've known Whiterun, it has been a city of peace and safety.
On one hand, Whiterun is the home I've always loved and protected. On the other hand, I'm sworn to you and will fight without question.
Except we don't have to. I believe in you, my Thane. You'll stop Alduin and restore hope. Then you'll come back to Whiterun, stronger and braver!
So let's secure this peace, okay? Help Whiterun help you.
Gods. Fine. Mara's calling was a big reason, but if there had been more exciting jobs around Whiterun, I might've stayed a mercenary.
Whiterun may not pay me a castle's worth of gold, but at least I'm content with all this. I don't have to envy you anymore.
While in Whiterun's camp, I overheard a conversation - meant for none but the traitors and the dead.
Whiterun... The Hold where I almost died. Though I guess I did, in some ways.
Can you hear the sound of coin clinking? Whiterun's people are rich. It means they eat well, and that makes their blood nutritious. Need I go on?
I always enjoy a hunt or two in Whiterun Hold. There's all types of prey, if you catch my drift.
Whiterun is not too unpleasant. The people here are generally agreeable, the tavern is well maintained, and the Court Wizard is capable.
The Gildergreen in Whiterun fascinates me, even as a dead husk. It radiates an ancient, almost primal magic.
And I thought the tree in Whiterun was impressive. This is simply magnificent.
The peace of Whiterun is well and good for a merchant, but there's no meat for someone who thrives on death.
My hometown once had a market as bustling as Whiterun's. Now, it's little more than a colony for the East Empire Company.
Whiterun is a decent town... but with a touch of magic, it can become magnificent.
Whiterun - city of the Companions, home to Olaf One-Eye. To walk its streets is to walk within living history.
Wherever you hail from, you'll always find a welcome fire and honest mead in Whiterun.
Histories fawn over Solitude and Windhelm, but they often overlook Whiterun. Its importance was - and remains - just as profound.

pointers.speaker: Torvar
pointers.words: Never thought I'd see the day Whiterun's guards boasted of dragon-slaying!
Kodlak stood taller than Kings or Emperors, for he never bent to them. His passing leaves a wound in Whiterun that won't heal for a long, long time.
A child in Whiterun swears a wolf walked the rooftops. Did you hear that?
Harbinger? There are whispers of werewolves near Whiterun. Some folk wonder if the Companions know of it.
Still, the people of Whiterun look to Jorrvaskr for answers, don't they?
(Sigh) I know. I will tell them the Companions guard Whiterun, day and night. That is answer enough to these idle flights of fancy.
Some claim Anoriath simply vanished from the market here in Whiterun. Others say he's dead. I haven't seen him for some time either...
There's a dragon bound by chains in the heart of Whiterun. If it breaks free, Whiterun burns.
Got offered coin by a thief I caught, asking me to 'look the other way', right here in Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Ria
pointers.words: I'm fine! Say, a merchant praised the Companions for clearing bandits from the road to Whiterun, somewhere off to the east. Were you there?

pointers.speaker: Skjor
pointers.words: The beast awakens within. Fight it, guide it. Leave Whiterun unblooded. If it overcomes you, or if you're seen, flee to the woods. I believe in you.

pointers.speaker: Vignar Gray-Mane
pointers.words: Aye. The people have chosen, the fortitude of arms have spoken, and the Empire's puppet has fallen. Whiterun stands with Skyrim now.
Whiterun was blessed with prosperity, but it may soon be challenged by the wars to come.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Then Whiterun it is.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Come on, let's get to Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Danica Pure-Spring
pointers.words: I thank you. Your deed honors the people of Whiterun.

pointers.speaker: Olaf

pointers.speaker: Manheim
pointers.words: Another case of mead needs to find its way to the Bannered Mare in Whiterun. The delivery fee is yours to keep.

pointers.speaker: Aumsi Fine-Hair
pointers.words: Whiterun is a such beautiful city. Have you ever seen the likes of this place?

pointers.speaker: Vilde Steel-Arm
pointers.words: It's the capital of Whiterun Hold, the biggest and the best of the nine holds of Skyrim. But don't take my word for it.

pointers.speaker: Thane Hroa Hearth-Healer
pointers.words: The goddess's divine blessings have no doubt helped make Whiterun a thriving and prosperous city.

pointers.speaker: Karlsten
pointers.words: Well, there might be nothing to it, but I've heard that the feud between the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns in Whiterun has grown ugly.

pointers.speaker: Vinopola Vlanarus
pointers.words: The road to Whiterun's not safe these days. Lots of travelers just... disappear, south of Dragon Bridge. Can't find a trace of them.

pointers.speaker: Erich Fine-Hair
pointers.words: Couldn't be better. Whiterun is perfect for a child- great weather, plenty of space, friends to play with. What more could you want?

pointers.speaker: Aumsi Fine-Hair
pointers.words: Couldn't be better. Whiterun is perfect for a child- great weather, plenty of space, friends to play with. What more could you want?
We taught that dragon not to mess with Whiterun, didn't we?

pointers.speaker: Caula Statlilia
pointers.words: There were several Khajiit camped outside the walls of Whiterun. Seems they've been traveling around the whole of Skyrim peddling their wares.

pointers.speaker: Aumsi Fine-Hair
pointers.words: Couldn't be better. Whiterun is perfect for a child- great weather, plenty of space, friends to play.

pointers.speaker: Remiel
pointers.words: Whiterun is the center of Skyrim's commerce, huh? That's how Wayrest is to High Rock. Yet they're so different from one another.

pointers.speaker: Remiel
pointers.words: Whiterun is a nice enough town, if a little plain.

pointers.speaker: Remiel
pointers.words: If I were the Jarl of Whiterun, I'd be very easy to convince to imprison a dragon in my keep. I imagine the real Jarl won't be quite so enthusiastic.
I mean, you've seen Braith in Whiterun, right?
By the Eight, how far did we travel? I thought I had more blisters than usual! Whiterun to Rorikstead to Markarth. All in one night? By Sheor.
I quite like the spooky dead tree near the Companions' guildhall. Although it doesn't quite fit the vision I have of Whiterun.
Well, let's let Danica know pilgrims will be running to Whiterun from all across Nirn. Do they pay her to look at the tree? I think I'm confused.
I will miss the spooky centerpiece to Whiterun, but I suppose an alive tree looks... nice enough.

pointers.speaker: Remiel
pointers.words: While we're here, Gore, I'll show you what a two-for-one deal is, okay? Whiterun's market is perfect for such a demonstration.
These Silver Hand call themselves werewolf hunters, yet their deeds reek of common brigandage. If Whiterun's Jarl won't deal with them, then we will.
Whiterun's fertile plains and extensive trade routes are Skyrim's greatest assets. Whatever the price, they must be secured.
When we secured Whiterun from the rebellion, the Civil War was already won.
Excellent. Whiterun is not only Skyrim's center of commerce, but also the heart of its food supply.
A bit bigger than the property in Whiterun, yeah?

pointers.speaker: Megara
pointers.words: The other day, I asked a guard in Whiterun if he knew the alphabet. He said no.
Where does Megara like to stay in Whiterun?

pointers.speaker: Megara
pointers.words: Whiterun? I'm so confused.

pointers.speaker: Megara
pointers.words: When I woke up, I was in the back of a wagon, headed for Whiterun, and...
Have you met Olava in Whiterun?

pointers.speaker: Idgrod the Younger
pointers.words: We were taking him to the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun, just so the healers could make sure he was in good health, and they say he's fine.

pointers.words: I tracked it to a group of bandits nearby. But I'm no fool. I'd need the Whiterun guards or maybe hire the Companions to get it.

pointers.words: Belethor has been selling stakes in the store to a few key individuals in Whiterun.
It's a modest beginning, but I'm determined to make a mark in Whiterun.
Business is on the rise, thanks to your support. Our store is becoming a trusted name in Whiterun.
Our store is thriving, thanks to your dedication. Customers trust us in Whiterun, and our supplier connections have grown stronger.
Together, we've achieved remarkable success! Our store is a cornerstone of Whiterun's commerce. Customers flock to us for quality and service.
And I thought Whiterun was dull...nothing exciting here at all.
Ah, Whiterun.  Where ambition goes to retire.

pointers.speaker: Taliesin
pointers.words: Oh there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red who came riding from Whiterun from Ol' Rorikstead!
So this is Breezehome. You'd think they'd have a bigger home available for Whiterun's Thane.
Just say the word...and I can make Whiterun a lot quieter.

pointers.speaker: Taliesin
pointers.words: The Thalmor never make that many visits to Whiterun. Probably because Balgruuf is too busy kneecapping himself to be much of a threat...

pointers.speaker: Taliesin
pointers.words: Ah, Whiterun has been a lot quieter since Heimskr's demise. You didn't have anything to do with that, did you? I won't tell.
Then again, in the Thalmor, I had no say in the tasks to which I was assigned. I guess we're playing the role of Whiterun's champions now. How grand.
The sooner we leave Whiterun the better.
Yes, I'm sure keeping Whiterun in pristine condition is far more important than stopping dragon that's prophesied to devour the world!
And the more I talk, the more I realized none of these events helped make Whiterun a safer place!
Oh yeah, Whiterun. You're lucky I'm around to keep you alive.
Oh yeah, Whiterun, You're lucky I find your scatterbrain tendencies adorable!
I mean, you did join the Companions to help protect Whiterun, but sure, lets go another direction then. Werewolves. What a twist.
When I'm in Whiterun, I always visit the Gildergreen. Never hurts to pay your respects to Lady Kynareth, particularly in my line of work.
Oh, there once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ole Rorikstead!
I bet you'll be glad to get to Whiterun and get out of this weather.
Morthal, capital of Hjaalmarch hold. Not quite in the same league as Solitude or Whiterun, but a nice enough place if you like swamps.
Never been to Whiterun before? The Jarl's palace is something to see. Dragonsreach they call it. Big old dragon skull hanging on the wall.
We really should warn the Jarl of Whiterun about what happened to Helgen. People are in danger.

pointers.speaker: Lucien Flavius
pointers.words: There once was a hero named Ragnar the Red, who came riding to Whiterun from ol' Rorikstead...

pointers.speaker: Lucien Flavius
pointers.words: Toss a coin to your hero, oh valley of Whiterun, oh valley of Whiterun, ohhh... now that is what I call an earworm.

pointers.speaker: Lucien Flavius
pointers.words: I do like Whiterun a lot. It would be a shame if it were completely obliterated by dragons.

pointers.speaker: Lucien Flavius
pointers.words: Whiterun, Whiterun, it's a wonderful town... dum dum, dum dum, doo bee doo doo dum dum...

pointers.speaker: Lucien Flavius
pointers.words: Oh, there once was a hero named Draelon the Dread, who came riding to Whiterun from old Rorkistead... wait, that's not exactly original, is it?
Oh, you'd be surprised! Most are just passing through between Rorikstead and Whiterun.
How are you feeling? You were out cold for hours after what happened back in Whiterun. Try not to push yourself too hard.

That rod will be awfully handy if we come up against Dwarven spiders. But how likely is that in Whiterun, exactly?

pointers.speaker: Ria
pointers.words: The people of Whiterun look up to the Companions. It's a responsibility we take seriously.

pointers.words: Five. Our leader, Paarthurnax, lives alone on the peak of the Throat of the World.

pointers.speaker: Esbern
pointers.words: Did you find the Elder Scroll? What happened when you took it back to the Throat of the World?

pointers.speaker: Inigo
pointers.words: I was remembering our battle with Alduin at the Throat of the World. I admit I wondered if we were going to survive at the time.

pointers.speaker: Sven
pointers.words: That's it. I'm composing a new song! An ode to the Throat of the World!

pointers.speaker: Barknar
pointers.words: I've been hunting in these parts all my life, living in the shadow of the Throat of the World.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.quest: Serana and the Throat of the World
pointers.words: You know? I've never been to the Throat of the World before. I read once that aurora borealis are common at the top. Always wanted to see them.

pointers.speaker: Serana
pointers.words: Do we really have to climb back the Throat of the World?

The Nords hold the Throat of the World sacred. We Orcs have a sacred mountain of our own, too.
For all its imposing stature, the Throat of the World would always calm me.
With Alduin's defeat at the Throat of the World, he has forever lost the dragons' respect for his rule.
Walking to Riften for pilgrimage is one thing, climbing all the way up the Throat of the World is another.
I thought the Throat of the World was massive, but the Red Mountain looks even more imposing from Solstheim.
Yes, when the sun rises from the west and the snow of the Throat of the World melts.
